findings_qualitative.value: SMG K-S relations are flatter with higher zero points than K98/D10; gas surface densities exceed Eddington-limit threshold

evidence.quote: our SMG $\Sigma_{\rm SFR}-\Sigma_{\rm gas}$ relations have flatter slopes and higher zero points than the K98 relation

claims.hypothesis: Do SMGs follow the K98/D10 K-S slope of ~1.4?
claims.experiment: Fit binned Sigma_SFR vs Sigma_gas using ALMA 870 um sizes
claims.finding: Sub-linear/quasi-linear, consistent with Eddington-limited disk expectation of unity

evidence.quote: the slightly sub-linear, or quasi-linear $\Sigma_{\rm SFR}-\Sigma_{\rm gas}$ relations we derived are in broad agreement with the theoretical expectation

claims.hypothesis: Does the choice of size scale affect the K-S law?
claims.experiment: Used 3 GHz radio sizes instead of dust sizes
claims.finding: Source size is a major bottleneck

evidence.quote: the source size can be one of the major bottlenecks in deriving the K-S law of SMGs
